product.name: Velara SmartPlug 2.0
product.description: The Velara SmartPlug 2.0 is a compact, Wi‑Fi enabled power strip that lets users control and monitor household appliances from any smartphone. Featuring two standard outlets and a built‑in surge protector, it supports up to 60 W per socket, ensuring safe operation for lamps, chargers, and small kitchen gadgets. The device connects via 802.11 b/g/n Wi‑Fi or Zigbee 3.0, offering flexible integration with existing smart‑home hubs. A dedicated app provides real‑time energy consumption data, scheduled on/off timers, and voice‑assistant compatibility. The sleek midnight‑gray enclosure is made from ABS plastic and copper wiring, and the plug is rated for 16 A. With a 12‑month warranty, the SmartPlug 2.0 delivers convenience and peace of mind for modern living spaces.
